mission: Verify admin and ordinary-account shared paths and permission, entitlement and ownership boundaries
scope: Real disposable source application, PostgreSQL, session routes and HTTP guards. External TCP/TLS/UDP denied; no real provider spending or production writes.

source.note: Checkout is base main plus exact PR211 source overlays; hashes identify tested files.

findings.before: Active paid subscriptions retaining a historical trial date were denied; admins bypassed the defect.
findings.after: Active paid conversion supersedes historical trial expiry; actual subscription expiry, MFA and account suspension still block.
findings.baseline: Original middleware failed 6 of the 17 regression cases.

findings.before: An admin without a public paid plan received403 from AI content optimization.
findings.after: The shared entitlement policy admits admin to ordinary input validation.
findings.limit: The400 validation response proves admission, not live AI generation.

findings.before: Inactive/canceled/past-due paid tier names were admitted, while active Pro was denied.
findings.after: Content analysis uses the shared current-entitlement policy.
findings.limit: Invalid asset requests fail before provider calls.

verified_workflows: Real registration cannot self-assign admin/lifetime entitlements
Admin and paid user create, persist and read projects through shared routes
Submitted owner IDs do not change the authenticated owner
Listings do not cross account boundaries
Another user and admin cannot read/update/delete foreign projects through ordinary feature routes
Paid users cannot enter admin dashboard; anonymous studio requests deny
Admin can use paid studio and reach AI input validation without buying a public plan
Free accounts cannot forge paid access
Active subscription after trial conversion succeeds; expired paid periods/unconverted trials fail
Concurrent project edits produce one acceptance and one conflict
Project data survives logout and real reauthentication
Admin privilege cannot bypass an unverified MFA challenge
Inactive content-analysis subscriptions deny and active Pro is admitted
limits: Not an acceptance of every feature in all twelve domains
No live AI, distribution, marketing delivery or external payment settlement verified
No process-restart persistence, backup restoration or deployment rollback drill in this run
Two concurrent edits test conflict handling, not public-scale capacity
Admin-private deployment configuration and deployed revision remain unverified
Source defaults permit registration and ordinary-account operation; deployed governance settings were unavailable
Replit status question returned busy/not-submitted and publication status was unavailable
No merge, publication or production mutation performed
counts_note: Separate suites and historical evidence are reported by scope; no historical counts are summed.
